upstream_issues.rationale: The pinned TCK sends one generic prompt to a domain-bounded research agent but expects different canned artifact and direct-Message scenarios. No request-visible semantic selector distinguishes those scenarios.

CORE-SEND-003 describes the required ContentTypeNotSupportedError but omits expected_error in its test data; the shared TCK validator consequently reports the correct non-2xx protocol error as an operation failure.

rationale: This policy accepts only exact failures from the pinned, unmodified TCK, each tied to a reviewed upstream issue and an exact failure signature. It does not alter product behavior, protocol validation, authentication, or the TCK.
